nom: DHC Concentrated Eye Cream Eye Moisturizer

avis.texte: I have been using this eye cream for the past five years. I have received numerous compliments about my appearance and asked about my skincare routine. I always mention this wonderful eye cream.
Have use DHC Eye Cream for years and love the results. Recently someone was looking at me and remarked how I had no wrinkles around my eyes despite mt 69 years,
DHC is a fabulous brand. Love this eye cream. I use it at night and Eye Bright in the morning.
This is a very great of product. It's lightweight but creamy and when tapped in moistens the eye area.
This eye cream does not irritate my eyes as some other products have done. I will continue buying this eye product because of this.
I have been using this eye cream for years, and I still love it. It doesn't irritate my eyes, and has really helped my crows feet.

avis.titre: Used this product for years and will continue using
avis.texte: I use this product in the morning since it absorbs quickly and gives me lasting moisture for the day. This is one of my favorite products from DHC
Keeps my eyes moisturized & young! Keep crows feet and laugh lines at bay! Been using it for many years. The best--try it!

I am definitely an older lady who has been using DHC products since 2005. They make my skin look and feel refreshed and everyone says " you look great and you can't be that old!" I have had no cosmetic surgery of any kind. I only use DHC skin care and never any other company's products on my face.
Highly recommended. Use it daily; morning and evening. One of the few products in the market for my eyes that my sensitive skin can handle.

I swim laps about once a week at the indoor pool. With the goggles tight under my eyes I come out with "goggle eyes" so I use the eye strips to keep the skin under my eyes from looking too baggy, it works!
Id been noticing my fine lines way more around my eyes but simcr using this they look dramatically better and my skin feels so smoother. Will be repurchasing from now on!!

The 5 stars and reviews really were what got me to buy this product. I have eczema and psoriasis and lately its been affecting my eyes with dry patches. I have always been an oily skin girly with acne but lately have been experiencing dry skin and dry patches on my eyelids. I bought this wanting to try something better than my elf cream but honestly, my elf eye cream gave me the same results or better. This didnt really hydrate much and caused me itchiness and more dry spots. Wouldnt recommend.
I wear contacts and this caused sever eye dryness and double vision. As soon as I stopped this my vision improved!

I have used this eye cream for probably 20 years and loved it. Every once in a while, as I think we all do on occasion, I try a different product - then I ask myself, "What were you thinking?" And come back home to DHC. I use the eye cream day and night, just the right amount of moisture, helps eye make-up glide on but doesn't interfere with it. Love it!!

avis.titre: My eyes have seen the light!
avis.texte: I work outside and see aging signs around my eyes. Using the mask overnight once per week, and the eye cream twice daily has made a big difference in only a few weeks.
This eyecream is light but moisturizers delicate skin without being greasy. My concealer applies nicely over it and last just as long. Important that it doesn't cause any burning or eye irritation
This is the only eye cream that I use every day. It absorbs very well and works under my cover cream the best. I have been using this for years!

I have tried several eye creams for my dark circles, and fine lines. I keep coming back to this one. It has lightened my dark circles, and has helped with my fine lines. A little bit goes a long way. I have been using this eye cream for several years now, and I won't change.
I've been using this eye cream for years and it hydrates like you won't believe! I'm a firm believer because it keeps my wrinkles at bay. It's amazing!
This is a lovely eye cream. And it's quite economical because you only need the tiniest bit.
This eye cream is great if you have sensitive eyes. No greasiness or residue goes in your eyes

I needed eye cream was completely out so I switched and noticed a difference in puffiness under my eyes so I ordered this item again which I have used now for a couple years. I works great and no more switching for me.

Have been using the concentrated eye cream for many years. I use it at night and cQ10 eye cream during the day. Over those years the area around my eyes have maintained the look and feel of my 'younger' eyes. I think I have to give concentrated eye cream the credit for that!!
I have also purchased this to use in my daily regimen. My eyes are tighter smoother and the skin is plump and glowing. I use after the Olive oil cream by DHC. My go to for dewy smooth skin.

The under eye patches work wonders for me! Hydrating and soothing, they also smooth out fine lines for a while. I reuse them a few times for a different reason. Since they are soft and have some sort of felt material on the outside, I put them under my eye heat pads that I have to use for dry eyes. It helps prevent the heated pads to damage my under eye area.

avis.titre: I like all the DHC products I've purchased.
avis.texte: I've been using the Concentrated Eye Cream for several years and am very satisfied with this product.

I like the consistency of this cream. A little bit covers a lot of the eye area. Although it's great with hydration, it doesn't do much for puffiness or dark circles. I think I'll lookout for other formulas within the company to try out.
I've used this for years and it's helped keep the area around my eyes from aging.
Im 80 years old. I've been using this product for at lease 5 years and use it daily. It's non greasy l, easily absorbed, and gentle. Im very happy with the results.
Excellent eye cream. Not greasy, absorbs to hydrate rather tan sit on top of eye area. Provided great hydration.
This cream seems to just sit on the surface of my skin and collects in the creases.
Effective at moisturizing the sensitive eye area resulting in a softer look.
I have had several jars of this and I hope soon I can order another jar. It's a good product.
This eye cream is soft and wonderful but I will never buy it again because it's just too expensive.
good product - doesn't make big changes, but relaxing, cooling to use.
Concentrated eye cream is wonderful! I have been using it for 15 years. The skin around my eyes is probably the least wrinkled of my face at 66
Unfortunately this gave me a bad allergic reaction and my eyes became red swollen and itchy. It felt really nice and moisturizing so disappointed I am unable to use it.

I picked this as one of my free samples to try with my last order and am amazed at how great it works. I use this eye cream at night and in the morning there are noticeably fewer lines around my eyes. I use it under my eyes, at the corners for the crow's feet, and also around the side of my eyes where I have some lines. I am now purchasing the full size!

I have used many, many eye creams over the last 40 years and have always been disappointed. This eye cream soaks in quickly and leaves my upper and lower eye lids feeling so much better! I hope it keeps working this way because it's looking like a WINNER!!
I've appreciated this touch to my eyes, especially in the area of crows feet!
Love this product. Sample size is perfect for travel. I have used this product for yrs. I have no wrinkles around my eyes, eyelids & the eleven lines are barely noticeable.

I haven't stayed with specific skin care products for long. DHK concentrated eye cream is an exception. I've strayed to try other eye creams but nothing measures up. Others may be less expensive or available without shipping but they never measure up. Its fairly priced, lasts a long time and there are actual results I can see. No more two-timing Concentrated Eye Cream for me. I'm going to remain loyal to this eye cream! You might say we're going steady.
I love this cream. It absorbs quickly and leaves my eye area well moisturized. Lines are diminished. I will definitely repurchase.

I use the Concentrated Eye Cream twice a day, (morning and night) every day! I am a 69 year old woman with dry skin and of course with aging comes the wrinkles and increased dryness, especially living in CO. The CEC is very moisturizing and non-irritating which is a must for me. I suffer from Blepharitis (a condition that can cause inflammation of the eyelids) but the CEC from DHC is my trusted eye cream!
I bought this eye cream after reading the reviews but I have to say so far Im disappointed. I havent seen results as well the consistancy is very thin. I wont be buying this again
I like the consistency, but have not used this product before. I would recommend it if you have very dry skin all around the eye.
I have used this eye cream for years and I love it. Safe to use and keeps wrinkles from developing.
I have been using this product for years best I have ever used

avis.titre: Many years of using DHC eye products.
avis.texte: I've been using this patches for years. Along with the concentrated eye cream, they give me fresh and smooth eye skin. These patches also help with puffiness. I don't see that they make much difference in the darkness under the eye.

This is a really nice eye cream. I have super sensitive eyes that will often get infected when I use eye creams, but this one doesn't bother my eyes at all (I don't, however, rub the cream too close to my eyelids). It's really helped with my under eye bags and circles!
Would like it thicker. The "gel" moisturizer is thicker than the cream in the eye cream. But it works.

This has got to be the eye cream of the century...maybe two! There are two main reasons why this excellent cream is a must for your eyes.... First, it doesn't bother your eyes....it is pure, non-greasy, and goes on with no effort. Second, it feels like silk....and provides the moisture eyes need to look rested and ready for whatever eye makeup you want to apply.

avis.titre: It will be my next purchase. I will appreciate it.
avis.texte: I used the samples that were sent to me and I have been really satisfied with the effect that it gives to my eyes
The best eye cream. Not stall irritatingnrar the eyes. Too bad it's too expensive to use on my entire face and neck!
The concentrated eye cream is by far the best I've ever used. From time to time I tried others. There is no comparison to this product. I recommend it to my friends.
My eyes were left beautifully hydrated without any residue. I highly recommend this product for those who are 65+ years old!

I have very sensitive skin, particularly around my eyes, and this is the only eye cream that I can use with no irritation or redness. I've successfully used it for years and will never switch. Thank you to DHC for the thoughtful use of ingredients!
been using this since 2007. It works great. not greasy absorbs quickly. I have fine lines around eyes and it diminishes the look of the lines.
The eye cream is wonderful not plumps up wrinkles and not just around the eyes

I've tried… Perlier.. Asam..Honest Beauty.. Beekman.. I don't understand the negative reviews.. it's lightweight, moisturizing, cool feeling… it's really the best!! I'm staying with DHC… simply put.. I hope someone listens to this review.. !! Thanks DHC!!!

I'm a DHC fan in general, but the Concentrated Eye Cream has a faint alcohol smell that I don't like. I don't know if it means anything, but I prefer my creams not to smell like alcohol. I do like that it comes in a glass, reusable jar. Yay for no plastic.
Only eye cream I will use. Light cream that just disappears into the fine skin around the eyes and does not make my eyes tear.

avis.titre: Great performance from this eye cream!
avis.texte: This eye cream is nice and gentle to the sensitive skin around my eyes. I use this daily and am very happy with the results.

At first I liked this cream, but after a week or two I noticed some little bumps forming under one of my eyes. I stopped using it, but the bumps turned into what seems like a little dry eczema patch that is taking a long time to go away.
The under eye masks are wonderful. You can feel the moisturizing and tightening immediately. Half an hour is enough time.
Cool and moisturing for sensitive eye area; this product also shrinks the bags under my eyes!
You just need a tiny amount of this eye cream to do the job. Feels very light on your eyelid.
I've been using this for many years and while I don't have movie star looks, at least I look the best that I can! This cream is non-greasy, easy to apply, and disappears quickly. I'm hooked.
Unfortunately I canmot use my recent purchase, what a waste. The jar fell and broke leaving glass shards in the cream, so maybe a plastic container is an alternative?
This is the only under eye cream I use. It goes on smooth and I add a lightener on top, because of dark skin under my eyes and this takes care of it. I'm 70 and I've used it for many years.
This cream used to give me all the moisture I needed, now I have to keep applying it throughout the day to stay soft and smooth - I have almost used the jar after only 2 weeks.
This eye cream lubricates well and definitely appears to keep wrinkles away.
This eye cream feels nice going on but doesn't seem to do much for my under eye puffiness or dark circles. I have yet to find an eye area product that really works for me.
Unfortunately, this product did not work for me. It completely dries out my under eyes and causes flaky skin. My skin is so sensitive in that area. Can't use the product
I use this morning and evening. Works well under makeup. Buy it, you won't be disappointed!

avis.titre: A way to delay signs of aging
avis.texte: I use this product every night and I noticed how it keep the area around my eyes wrinkle free!
I use this product around my eye area and on my upper lip, I allow it to absorb a few minutes before using an all over facial moisturizer

avis.titre: The best eye cream I have ever tried
avis.texte: It's exactly the first eye cream I have tried that doesn't cause any pimples or clog my pores. It also improved my lines around my eye greatly in only one week. GREAT QUALITY!!!
I bought the eye cream after tying this! It makes my concealer go on so much better and makes a big difference!
Love the feel of concentrated eye cream and the must have lip balm.

I have purchased this before, and the way it makes my skin feel is great...more than that, I don't worry about getting it in my eyes because it is not greasy. It stays where I put it! On the areas around my eyes...

avis.titre: Keeps My Upper & Lower Eyelids Moist All Day
avis.texte: I like the eyecream because after one application my eyelids are moist all day.
I've tried so many expensive eye creams but have been using this religiously for over a year now. It's so hydrating and light, absorbs super quickly

I've been using a couple of samples of this eye cream for 5 days and am in love with it! The skin around my eyes looks brighter and more toned. I keep looking in the mirror to be sure I'm really seeing this. I love the consistency and the way it sinks into the skin. I just bought a full jar and it shipped today, which is a good thing as I'm running out of my samples. A little goes a long way, so one sample is good for about 6 applications or 3 days. I should have taken a before picture to show the difference...but take my word for it, this eye cream is the best.
The cream in combination with these strips are exactly what you need if you want your eyes to look refreshed and youthful.
Great eye cream! Only need just a touch at each eye area for coverage. Smoothes wrinkles around the eye, does not irritate the delicate eye tissue.

avis.titre: Can see why this is popular
avis.texte: If U don't put too close to your eyes this will not make your eyes water! the best I found!

I love using the DHC Concentrated Eye Cream because it adds so much moisture and plumps up the fine wrinkles around my eyes. I use this at night and before applying Velvet Skin Care to my face. It's not greasy and goes on smoothly so there's no makeup buildup. Would definitely recommend!

Ahhhsome! Too much screen time, smoke and pollutants are not going to beat my eyes or increase the luggage under my eyes. " As you age " can be managed by a bit of spoiling, and both of these products take minimal time. The cream is light and a little spreads a long way, The strips are a great way to go to bed.

avis.titre: The eyes have it!  Best eye cream available!
avis.texte: Concentrated Eye Cream is great! It is easy to apply and does not leave a greasy film.
I have been using this product for a very long time, as I got older the lines on my face and eyes have not gotten as old as I have.

I wish I would have read the negative reviews first. I was looking for something that would moisturize my under-eye area as well as help with dark circles and possible bags. This product did not do it for me. The area looks more tired and puffier. All the wrinkles are now in plain sight. Looks like I haven't slept in several days. I look haggard.

avis.titre: Superb Product! No dark patches under my eyes!
avis.texte: This eye cream is the only one I can use without any eye irritation to help with dry eye skin. The special bonus is the dark patches under my eyes completely disappeared after a month. I use it every morning and night.
I hated it! The area under my eyes went from moisturized and plum, to dry and crepe-like using this product. It's extremely drying! I went back to what I was using before. This was awful!!
I have used DHC products for so many years. I am 86 in this photo. I love their EFG Cream.
I like this eye cream because it is light and absorbs quickly. This is the best I have found for my dry skin and wrinkles. It really does moisturize.
I've used DHC for years. I'm 86. No one ever guesses my age! I not only use Moisture Strips, I also use Concentrated Eye Cream and swear by EGF Cream! I use them all daily. Thank you DHC!
This eye cream is a wonder!! Super hydrating but not greasy! These 57 yr old eyes thank you!!!

avis.titre: Got questioned about where my wrinkles went
avis.texte: This is a very nice eye cream. I had a friend who asked where did my wrinkles go. I thought he was over exaggerating but he had no idea I was using new facial products and said my wrinkles were noticeably less. Not sure I completely agree with that, but I appreciated the comment and I will order more of this eye cream!
While this product did not irritate my eyes, I think it makes them look more tired, wrinkled, and puffy. Very disappointed.
A little to lightweight for me. It feels nice on my skin, but I prefer a thicker cream for my eyes.
Love this eye cream! Been using it for years and still don't have a single wrinkle at 41.
This eye cream is super emollient and absorbs well. I love it mostly because it doesn't irritate my eyes the way other eye creams do.
I like this eye cream. But it's on a par with many other eye creams that cost less.
Perfect eye cream. Really makes a difference, day and night use works.

avis.titre: Fantastic Eye Cream - you won't be disappointed
avis.texte: Great eye cream! I've purchased this eye cream several times before. You will notice a difference after you first apply it, but after using it regularly you will really see the difference in how healthy your skin looks under your eyes. I highly recommend it
This eye cream is so light and absorbs very well; my eyes love it!
